### OBL-032 — Accuracy of public claims on the published prototype

| Field              | Value                                                   |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Source             | Massachusetts Office of the Attorney General (SRC-014)  |
| Authority type     | official-guidance                                       |
| Citation           | AGO AI Advisory; M.G.L. c. 93A as referenced therein    |
| Locator            | https://www.mass.gov/doc/ago-ai-advisory-41624/download |
| Source version     | 2024-04-16                                              |
| Verified on        | 2026-08-19                                              |
| Jurisdiction       | US-MA                                                   |
| Applicability      | APPLIES-NOW                                             |
| Trigger            | A public surface exists at a reachable URL.             |
| Control family     | CLAIMS / TRANSPARENCY                                   |
| Control status     | IMPLEMENTED                                             |
| Evidence status    | CURRENT                                                 |
| Owning route       | WP-037 publication boundary; maintained continuously    |
| Review requirement | none recorded                                           |
| Review trigger     | Every publication                                       |

**What the source states.** The advisory states that existing consumer protection law applies. It does not enumerate product wording.

**Obligation.** Consumer protection law applies to representations made about a product, including capability, security, privacy and compliance statements.

**SSLS interpretation.** Publication is not release, and the published surface must say so. Every status shown must be traceable to a recorded fact.

**Current phase.** Applies now. A public prototype is published and reachable.

**Future phase.** Applies with greater consequence as commercial intent becomes explicit.

**Required control.** Publication boundary statement plus traceable status rendering.

**Current control.** PUBLIC PROTOTYPE boundary recorded in WP-037, refused-claims surface in the application, and authority never derived from implementation status.

**Evidence required.** Reachability evidence plus surface review against the claims register. Minimum method: Recorded evidence plus human review.

**Claim permitted.** SSLS may describe the published surface as a public prototype that is not a release.

**Claim refused.** Production ready; district ready; live product

### OBL-033 — Zero personal data on the current surface

| Field              | Value                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Source             | Massachusetts Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation (SRC-011)                                                         |
| Authority type     | regulation                                                                                                                         |
| Citation           | 201 CMR 17.01 scope                                                                                                                |
| Locator            | https://www.mass.gov/doc/201-cmr-17-standards-for-the-protection-of-personal-information-of-residents-of-the-commonwealth/download |
| Source version     | Current published edition                                                                                                          |
| Verified on        | 2026-08-19                                                                                                                         |
| Jurisdiction       | US-MA                                                                                                                              |
| Applicability      | APPLIES-NOW                                                                                                                        |
| Trigger            | The scope test is continuous: the obligation attaches the moment personal information is received.                                 |
| Control family     | DATA MINIMIZATION                                                                                                                  |
| Control status     | IMPLEMENTED                                                                                                                        |
| Evidence status    | CURRENT                                                                                                                            |
| Owning route       | WP-038 verification; maintained continuously                                                                                       |
| Review requirement | none recorded                                                                                                                      |
| Review trigger     | Any added form, account, analytics or third-party script                                                                           |

**What the source states.** 17.01 states the scope. It does not describe web surfaces specifically.

**Obligation.** The regulation attaches to any person that receives, stores, maintains, processes or has access to personal information about a Massachusetts resident.

**SSLS interpretation.** Keeping the collection surface empty is the cheapest available control, and it must be verified rather than assumed.

**Current phase.** Applies now as a boundary to hold, not as a duty being discharged. The current surface collects nothing.

**Future phase.** The moment any form, account or analytics capture is added, OBL-009 to OBL-012 attach.

**Required control.** Verified absence of collection: no accounts, no forms that transmit, no analytics, no third-party trackers.

**Current control.** Verified at WP-038: no authentication, no submitting forms, no analytics or tracking scripts, no third-party data calls. One first-party sidebar preference cookie is set by the interface. Platform error reporting is invoked only if the host injects it.

**Evidence required.** Repeatable scan of the source tree for collection paths. Minimum method: Automated boundary scan plus code review.

**Claim permitted.** SSLS may state that the current surface collects no personal information and sets one first-party preference cookie.

**Claim refused.** Privacy compliant; no cookies; no tracking of any kind

**Note.** The sidebar preference cookie is recorded rather than omitted, because a no-cookies claim would be inaccurate.
